label: Tournament Access
description: Closes a tournament server to everyone not on the roster the tournament hub writes into the server's Redis: once the hub enforces it, others are kicked as they load and casters stay in spectator. The server owner and players at the bypass permission level are never checked.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns the roster check on. It also needs a Tournament ID, and the hub must mark the roster as enforced.

cvars.label: Tournament ID
cvars.description: Hub tournament whose roster this server uses. 0 turns the check off.

cvars.label: Bypass Permission
cvars.description: Players with at least this minqlx permission level skip the roster check.
